repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jSpi3g1dQNTvN6zEuH

## 席位核对

L1 (L1-e) on head `3e7995a73b6f2176048981406fb832391a61c2e1`, card #36372: **REWORK**. One item is owed, and it is evidence, not code. If the live run below passes as it stands, the head can stay where it is, and I re-read and give a delta ACCEPT on the same head.

**Owed**
1. **One end-to-end live run, because the card's acceptance asks for one and none was run.** Every acceptance line that crosses the `/meta` boundary is pinned only against a mocked client (`DashboardView.inPageEdit-36372.test.tsx`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts`), and the screenshots come from a static harness with no backend. The value of this card is what the server does with three writes: a draft under `ifNoneMatch: '*'`, a per-item `publish` with `?package=`, and for an installed app the override body declared into `<base>.custom`. This is the first time a dashboard goes through that per-item publish into a customization pair from the console. Against a fresh local backend and the console (as #36397 did), report readings for each of these:
   - On a writable package's dashboard: drag one card, widen one card, add one card and delete one card, then **Save**. After a reload the layout holds. The network shows only the dashboard's draft write and its `/publish`, with no package-wide publish.
   - On a read-only/installed app's dashboard (showcase, or HotCRM if it is available): **Save** lands in `<base>.custom` with `overrides: { package, basedOn }`. After a reload the change shows on the page, and Studio's Interfaces shows the same change.
   - **Discard** after a change leaves the page as it was. A card with an opted-out time filter carries the mark, and does not change when the top filter changes. After its switch is turned on and saved, the mark is gone and the card follows the filter.
   - Put the screenshots of the edit state and of a marked card from this live run in the PR body's Acceptance notes, next to the readings. They replace the harness shots. As on #36397, they cannot be uploaded to GitHub from the cloud, so name where they are held.

**Checklist (all pass)**
- Shape and card (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36405`, CLEAN): open, draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36372`, no keyword near another card. `Fixes` is right once (1) holds: items 1–10 are built, and the five 不做 items are kept out.
- Scope: 30 files. The test outside the card's files (`AppContent.dashboardRouteReads-28784`) only gains `useStudioEntryGate: () => null` in an existing mock, with no assertion changed. **Deviation 3 is accepted.**
- Deviation 1 is accepted: `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` is unchanged, and `boundToPackage` wraps exactly the three calls that function makes (`save`, `publish`, `reset`; its `invalidateViewCaches` reads `ctx.dataSource` only). I read #36398's patch to the same function at `5bdea0f911`. It adds `packageId` to `save` for `type === 'view'` only, and adds no client call, so the two compose. MetadataClient's `publish`/`reset` already take `packageId` as `?package=`.
- Deviation 2 (Edit from `sm` up, no handle on a phone) is accepted. The card says nothing about phones, and the panel needs the width.
- Changeset `patch` on core / i18n / plugin-dashboard / app-shell, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. It matches the diff: one new core export, two optional renderer props, new i18n keys, nothing removed. app-shell is private. (L2 is the seat's.)
- Changeset, `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` and `plugin-dashboard/README.md`, read sentence by sentence against the code: true. That covers the gate (`useStudioEntryGate` on `/studio/<pkg>`), the edit-state header, the dashed cards, track-snapped resize (`resizedSpan` rounds by pitch, clamps `1..maxColumns`, arrow keys), no handle under the phone breakpoint, "Add filter" drawn before any filter exists, save to the owner or the pair, refusal over a pending draft, and the mark computed by `resolveBoundField`.
- Gates at this head: 52 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are `success`. dogfood is not owed.
- Mark versus data: the renderer calls `buildWidgetScopedFilter(widgetArm, filterDefs, filterValues, undefined, …)`, so no `knownFields` skip happens in this path. `dashboardFiltersNotApplied` and the query therefore read the same `resolveBoundField`, and the claim "cannot disagree" holds for the page.
- SQL push-down: not applicable (no new data read; the mark is computed client-side over the definitions).

**Nits (not blocking)**
- The PR body opens with the seat signature line above the attribution comment. #36397 opens with the attribution. Align the order when the body is next edited.
- In the edit state, leaving the page with unsaved changes drops them without asking. #36362 adds the unsaved-edits seam (`useRegisterUnsavedEdits`), so a later card could register it here.
- Docs and README: "one whose `targetWidgets` leaves it out" is true only when there is no explicit string binding. An explicit `filterBindings[name]: 'field'` wins over `targetWidgets` (`resolveBoundField`). Worth a clause.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `3e7995a73b6f2176048981406fb832391a61c2e1`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36372 body and its four comments (notice, triage, claim, os-dev-report), the PR #36405 body, its 30-file list, the net diff against main (merge base `3faabd2675`), and the check-runs on this head. Every check-run concluded success or skipped. The skipped ones are opt-in or covered jobs (UI Published Artifacts, Temporal Conformance, Packed-tarball smoke, Dogfood Verify CLI, 18.x upgrade harness, queue verdicts, Build Core). Code outside the diff was read to judge the diff, never reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/core` adds the export `dashboardFiltersNotApplied`. It is additive and right. It filters `defs` on `resolveBoundField`, the same helper `buildWidgetScopedFilter` uses. The renderer calls `buildWidgetScopedFilter` with no `knownFields`, so no default binding is dropped on the query side that the mark would miss. The claim that the mark and the query cannot disagree holds at this call site.
- `DashboardRenderer` gains two optional props, `onWidgetResize` and `onAddFilter`. They are additive and right. Both draw only in design mode and only when passed. Studio's canvas passes neither. The filter bar with no filters is drawn only for `designMode` with `onAddFilter`.
- `DashboardFilterBar` gains `onAddFilter` and the file exports `useDashboardFilterLabeler`. Neither is public: the package index does not export that file. Right to leave out of the declaration.
- `@object-ui/i18n` adds `dashboard.inPageEdit.*` (16 keys), `dashboard.filters.notApplied` and `dashboard.filters.addFilter` in all 11 locales, 20 lines each. Additive and right. The i18n parity suites run inside Test UI, which is green.
- The metadata accept-set does not move. The editor writes only keys a dashboard already takes: `widgets`, `layout` w and h, `globalFilters`, `filterBindings`, `label`, and `overrides` with `package` and `basedOn` on the customization pair. No spec file is in the diff. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- The view-mode render changes for every dashboard reader: a card any page filter does not reach now carries a mark. This is card item 8 and is intended.
- New write path. The page now calls the `/meta` draft, per-item publish and discard doors with `?package=` named, and the ensure-customization door. Every one of these is a server-gated door Studio already calls, so the console gate (`useStudioEntryGate`: workspace admin, `manage_metadata`, a listed non-kernel package, fail-closed while unread) is a courtesy and the server stays the authority. No path the server refuses Studio is opened here. A kernel package gets no Edit button. A walled tenancy posture, an environment dashboard in an installed app and an item without a base version all reach a door the server refuses, and the page shows that refusal. No security-sensitive mechanism was found.
- `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` is untouched. `boundToPackage` wraps only `save`, `publish` and `reset`, which are the only client calls the door makes; `invalidateViewCaches` reads only `dataSource`. The wrapper is sound and the package is named on all three writes. The test pins `packageId` on draft and publish for both the owning package and `crm.custom`.
- M1 (must-fix). Clicking Edit writes before any save. `openDashboardForEdit` calls `resolveDashboardSaveTarget` first, and for a read-only owner that calls `ensureCustomizationPackage`, a POST that creates the base's `.custom` pair on first use. So on an installed app, Edit then Discard leaves a new package behind. That breaks card acceptance "做了改动后点「放弃」：和进来之前一样" on the installed-app branch that card item 10 requires. It also breaks the PR's own claim "Discard writes nothing" and Studio's contract for the same door ("Pressing it only unlocks the item's editors: nothing is written until the first edit is saved"; packages-io: "a write into the pair takes the pair's id from the ensure door", reads use `listedCustomizationPairOf`). The Discard test only covers a writable package, and the test doors stub ensure, so nothing pins this. Fix: at open, resolve the pair for reading with `listedCustomizationPairOf` (no pair listed means no pending draft, and the base's document opens, which the code already does). Call the ensure door at Save only. Add a test that Edit then Discard on a read-only package calls ensure zero times.
- S1 (should-fix). The edit state opens where Studio's Customize would refuse up front. Studio disables Customize with a stated reason when the ensure door is walled for this caller (`useCustomizeDoorWalled`) or the base lists no version (`noVersion`). The page reads neither. In the walled case Edit fails with the generic no-package toast. In the no-version case the admin can edit, and then Save fails with "could not be saved", because `dashboardSaveBody` returns null and the outcome is `invalid-body`. Check both at open and refuse with the reason, as Studio does.

SQL push-down: the diff adds no data query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The mark is computed from the dashboard's own metadata. Nothing to push down.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset bumps `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/app-shell` at `patch`. Those are every package the diff moves. The first three publish. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, and listing it is harmless. The docs and README edits publish nothing.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` means `patch` by the AGENTS.md rule. A non-protocol widening ships `patch`. The level is right.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right. The diff adds one export, two optional props and new i18n keys, and removes or renames nothing public. The line appears line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, as AGENTS.md asks. Check Changeset is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Deviation 1, `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` not widened: accepted. The wrapper covers every call the door makes (see ①). The appended functions sit after that function, so the overlap with #36398 is the dev's claim and the merge queue decides.
- Deviation 2, Edit offered from `sm` up and no corner handle on a phone: accepted. The card asks for no phone editing.
- Deviation 3, `AppContent.dashboardRouteReads-28784.test.tsx` touched: accepted. It only adds `useStudioEntryGate` to an existing mock and changes no assertion.
- S2 (should-fix). Deviation 4: card acceptance asks for screenshots in the PR body ("PR 正文附编辑状态和带标记的卡片截图"). They are only in the project thread. Attach them to the PR body, or have the seat record the waiver on the card.
- Card "没有核对的": Studio save without a package publish is answered by the per-item publish door of ruling 7058616478, and the card's maintainer quote "是，保存即生效" covers it. Grid columns and the minimum card size are answered by `resizedSpan`, which clamps to the grid's columns (4 by default) and to one track. Ordinary members are answered by the gate test, which pins no button behind the gate.
- Claim's serial constraint with #36373: no panel wording changed, so no rebase is owed. Accepted.
- Escalated, not graded. The PR realises an ADR-0146 D1 amendment row filed on #36086 ("Studio owns all metadata"), and reverses the `DashboardView` note that the in-page editor was retired for a single authoring surface. The maintainer's "我同意先做页面上的「编辑」" on the card authorises the feature. Whether that D1 row is accepted is not in these inputs. The seat should confirm it lands before or with this PR.
- Noted, not graded. The mark reads "Not filtered by Region" (zh 「不跟随『区域』筛选」), not the card's example "时间固定为今年". The card gave it as an example, and that wording was the coordinator's own addition.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jSpi3g1dQNTvN6zEuH

**L1 delta ACCEPT** on head `f0750e0ddb2a638b2cf0c3c57e16d549ac10b355` (#36372). This supersedes REWORK 7078067896.

**What the REWORK owed, and where it is now**
- **Live run, card acceptance.** The PR body's Acceptance notes carry a live run on both legs.
  - Writable leg: Save sends only `PUT ?mode=draft&package=` and `POST /publish`, and the layout holds after reload.
  - Installed leg: Edit then Discard writes nothing and creates no `.custom` package. Save calls ensure-customization, then PUTs into `com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides {package, basedOn: "0.1.0"}`, then publishes. Studio Interfaces shows the change.
  - The filter mark and the edit switch behave as the card asks.
- **Live `/meta` per-item publish into `<base>.custom`.** Measured in the installed leg above.
- **Harness shots.** Replaced by live screenshots under `repo-objectstack-7/shots/36372/`, which are present.

**Delta code, read in full** (one commit, 22 files, +349/−95)
- **M1.** `openDashboardForEdit` only reads now. The `.custom` package is ensured at Save, through `ensureDashboardSaveTarget`. Opening refuses with `'walled'` (`useCustomizeDoorWalled`) and with `'no-version'`, and each refusal has an i18n key (`dashboard.inPageEdit.walled` and `dashboard.inPageEdit.noVersion`).
- **S1.** Reads correct.
- **Two bugs the live run found, both fixed and pinned.**
  - `editSchema` re-adds `_packageId`, so edit-mode dataset queries keep `?callerPackage=`.
  - `WidgetFilterMark` falls back to `t('dashboard.filters.dateRange')` for `type: dateRange`.

**Sentences**
- The changeset and the docs now say that opening the editor writes nothing, and that an explicit string binding wins over `targetWidgets`. Both match the code.
- The unsaved-edits gap is stated as known and not claimed as closed. That is acceptable.

**Mechanical reads**
- l1-face is CLEAN: 54 success, 12 skipped.
- Deviations 1–3 stay accepted as before.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `f0750e0ddb2a638b2cf0c3c57e16d549ac10b355`
Local-runs: none

Delta review against the FAIL record 7078097551 at `3e7995a73b6f2176048981406fb832391a61c2e1`. Inputs read: card #36372 body and its comments (no new comment since that record), the PR #36405 body as it now stands, its 30-file list, the delta `3e7995a73b6..f0750e0ddb2`, and the check-runs on this head. The delta is one commit whose parent is the prior head. It holds no merge from main, so every hunk in it is the PR's own. It touches 22 files, +349 and -95. Every check-run on this head concluded success or skipped. The skipped ones are the same opt-in or covered jobs as last round. Code outside the diff was read to judge the diff, never reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- M1: closed. `resolveDashboardEditTarget` now reads the package list only, and names the pair through `listedCustomizationPairOf`, the read Studio makes of a pair. `openDashboardForEdit` then makes only `getDraft` and `layered` reads. A pair that is not listed yet skips both reads and opens the base's document. The ensure door is asked in `ensureDashboardSaveTarget`, which only `save` calls. The pair id a write uses comes from the ensure answer, as the packages-io rule asks. The view test pins zero ensure calls, and no save, publish or reset, for Edit then Discard on a read-only package. The installed Save test pins ensure called once, at Save only.
- M1 re-break attempts, none found. (a) Draft autosave: the edit buffer is React state only, and nothing in `DashboardView`, the editor, `DashboardWidgetInspector` or `DashboardDefaultInspector` writes it out on change. (b) Inline dataset create: the widget inspector draws New dataset only inside `StudioDatasetAuthoringContext`, which only the Studio design surface provides, so the page never draws it. (c) Layout persist: the renderer and grid leave persistence to the parent, and the page's `onWidgetsReorder` and `onWidgetResize` only change the buffer. (d) Preview fetches: the dataset catalog is asked with `previewDrafts: false` here, and card queries are reads. (e) The edit gate and the walled hook are reads. A save the server refuses after the ensure door has made the pair leaves that pair behind. That follows a Save, as Studio's first saved customization does, so it is not an open-time write.
- S1: closed. A customization target is refused before any item read when `useCustomizeDoorWalled` is true, with its own toast. An item that declares no override, on a base with no listed version, is refused at open as `no-version` with its own toast. An item that already declares its override still opens. This matches Studio's two blocks: walled first, then noVersion only when the item is not in the pair yet. The view test pins the walled case with no ensure call and no layered read. The editor test pins no-version and its exception.
- The callerPackage fix is right and cannot widen a read. The edit state now draws the buffer with the served `_packageId` spread last. That is the value view mode already sends for the same dashboard, and it overrides any `_packageId` the stored document might carry, including when the served one is absent. `servedPackageId` reads that one key and drops the packageless ids. The panel still gets the bare buffer, and both save bodies drop every top-level `_` key, so the key never reaches a write. The edit state therefore names no package that view mode does not already name. The test pins `callerPackage: 'crm'` on every query in both modes.
- The date filter label fix is right. An unlabelled `dateRange` filter now reads the same "Date range" key and fallback the filter bar uses. A test pins the text with the query beside it.
- Public surface in the delta: two new keys, `dashboard.inPageEdit.walled` and `dashboard.inPageEdit.noVersion`, in all 11 locales. They fall under the declared `dashboard.inPageEdit.*`. The renamed and new functions and types (`resolveDashboardEditTarget`, `ensureDashboardSaveTarget`, `DashboardEditTarget`, `DashboardEditRefusal`) are in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is private, and none existed on main. The metadata accept-set does not move. `Metadata-protocol: none` stays right.
- SQL push-down: the delta adds no data query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. It restores one query parameter. Nothing to push down. No security-sensitive mechanism was found.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset still bumps `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/app-shell` at `patch`. The delta moves app-shell, i18n and plugin-dashboard, all already listed. The level is right under `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` stays right. The delta adds keys inside the declared i18n set and removes or renames nothing on main. The line is line-initial in the PR body and the changeset. Check Changeset is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- S2: closed. The card asks for screenshots in the PR body. The body now names each shot, what it shows, and where it is (`repo-objectstack-7/shots/36372/` in the project files), and says a cloud container cannot upload images to a PR. Merged #36397 met the same card wording the same way. A one-line waiver on the card would make the record complete, but it is not owed for this verdict.
- L1-e REWORK 7078067896: the body now carries a live run on this head for every reading it asked for. It covers the writable leg with only the item's draft and its per-item publish, the reload, and the installed leg with Edit then Discard leaving the package list unchanged. It also covers Save into the base's .custom pair with `overrides`, Studio's view of the result, and the mark and its switch. The two defects that run found are the two fixes in ① above. Whether that meets the REWORK is L1-e's call, not graded here.
- Noted, not graded. While the tenancy posture is still unread, the walled hook reads false. The server's 403 at Save then answers, and the page shows its sentence. This matches Studio, and the server stays the judge.
- Carried from the prior record, unchanged: the ADR-0146 D1 amendment row on #36086 is still escalated to the seat, and the known gap of unsaved edits lost on leaving is out of this card.
